intro: A machine learning engineer resume about models in production: serving, monitoring and the gains they brought, not just training accuracy.
tips: Show models running in production, with latency and scale.
Name the metric each model improved for the business.
Mention the pipeline work: data, evaluation, monitoring.

basics.name: Lukas Becker
basics.label: Machine Learning Engineer
basics.summary: Machine learning engineer with six years putting ranking and language models into production. I care about evaluation, cost and what happens after launch.

work.name: Streamio
highlights: Shipped a two-tower recommendation model serving 8,000 requests a second under 30 ms; listening time rose 4%.
Built the offline evaluation suite that every model change now passes before launch.
Cut GPU inference costs by 35% by distilling and quantising models.

work.name: Textwerk
highlights: Fine-tuned language models for document classification; accuracy rose from 81% to 93%.
Set up drift monitoring that caught two data-quality incidents before customers did.
